invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null map (partitionSmallFilesMap is instantiated to new HashMap at the beginning and returned either directly or after population).
A mapping is created only for entries of partitionPaths, so the result can't have more keys than partitionPaths.
Each key in result corresponds to a partitionPath given in partitionPaths.
Non-empty result means partitionPaths was provided as non-null.
Each mapped value for a partition path is a non-null list according to how values are constructed in mapToPair.
